name: Ramon Rojo
source:
Age: late 30s
Gift: Emotional Aura Reader and ███████
----

Having grown up in the church for as long as he can remember, Ramon views that blood monsters that descend from the moon as angels, brought here to restore the planet back to the paradise it once was. His love for his faith and family drive him to help raise a prosperous community. He is a spiritual leader, a figurehead of his community, a loving father and an entrepreneur. Following the teachings of Father, Ramon hopes to help those who feel lost, and to bring a brighter future to all.
